visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an extreme close-up of a silver spoon scooping a large portion of purple sticky rice mixed with creamy white taro paste. The texture appears soft and glutinous. In the background, blurred containers of other desserts are visible under bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to an exterior shot of a storefront named '夏爾沫' (Shure More). The building has a grey facade and a green awning. A person wearing a beige hooded jacket stands at the service window, and a staff member is partially visible inside. The sky is bright but overcast. (3) A close-up shows a black-gloved hand using a spatula to smooth out a large container of thick, pale-purple taro paste. This is followed by a shot of a rectangular plastic container filled with purple rice, with the lid being partially lifted. (4) A metal tool slices through the dense purple rice cake inside the container, revealing a thick, smooth layer of taro paste sandwiched in the middle. The camera focuses on the soft, elastic texture of the rice as it is pulled apart. (5) Three transparent dessert boxes are stacked vertically, showcasing layers of strawberries, matcha, and taro. A hand picks up the top box (strawberry). Close-up shots show spoons scooping out generous portions of the strawberry-cream-pudding layers, the taro-custard layers, and the matcha-taro layers. (6) A square plastic bottle labeled 'share_more' is shown, containing white milk and purple taro chunks. The milk is then poured into a white cup with a blue rim, showing its creamy consistency and the visible taro sediments. (7) The video concludes with a view of a refrigerator filled with rows of dessert boxes, followed by a final shot of the store's exterior with a large text overlay displaying the store's address and name.
